description: Your one-stop destination for expert-guided Ayurvedic wellness, delivered digitally

colors.paletteDirection: Warm earthy amber-brown primary with rich forest green accent — classic Ayurvedic healing palette blending earth (rootedness) and nature (vitality)

typography.analysis: Serif-heavy heading stack (Playfair Display signals heritage/luxury, EB Garamond signals tradition/authority, Lora signals readability) paired with clean Noto Sans body. The serif-to-sans-serif bridge mirrors the ancient-to-modern brand promise.

targetAudience: Health-conscious individuals seeking authentic Ayurvedic wellness guidance online, plus Ayurvedic practitioners and consultants looking for a digital platform to offer consultations and grow their practice

targetAudienceBreakdown.primary: Wellness-seeking individuals aged 25–55 interested in holistic health, alternative medicine, and personalized Ayurvedic consultations delivered remotely
targetAudienceBreakdown.secondary: Ayurvedic practitioners, wellness consultants, and traditional healers seeking a technology platform to reach clients, manage bookings, and digitize their practice
signals: Two-sided marketplace with distinct client and consultant portals
Language around 'expert-guided' and 'professional' signals B2C trust-building
Pitta/Vata/Kapha dosha education suggests audience familiar with or curious about Ayurveda fundamentals
.tech domain signals tech-savvy positioning despite traditional subject matter

conversionDetails.clientPath: Register/Login on client.ayurveda.tech to book a consultation
conversionDetails.consultantPath: Join/Login on consultant.ayurveda.tech to offer services
conversionDetails.analysis: Dual-path conversion model — visitors choose their role (client or consultant) at the point of entry. This reduces friction but risks decision paralysis if value propositions aren't immediately clear for each path.

toneAnalysis.formality: Professional but inviting — mixes educational authority ('Ancient Wisdom') with accessible language ('Modern Wellness')
toneAnalysis.contractions: Likely minimal given professional Ayurvedic positioning
toneAnalysis.jargon: Uses Ayurvedic terminology (Vata, Pitta, Kapha, dosha) positioning the brand as knowledgeable insider, not a generic wellness site
toneAnalysis.emotionalAppeal: Aspirational + Trust — appeals to desire for holistic well-being while emphasizing expert guidance
toneAnalysis.voice: The wise guide — knowledgeable, reassuring, bridge-builder between old and new

stylePreferences: Serif-dominant typography (Playfair Display, EB Garamond) paired with clean sans-serif body text — heritage meets modern clarity
Warm earthy color palette with amber-brown and forest green — grounded, natural, healing-focused
Content-forward layout with dosha education, consultation pathways, and wellness library — knowledge as conversion driver
keyDifferentiators: Bridges ancient Ayurvedic wisdom with modern .tech digital delivery
Two-sided marketplace connecting clients AND practitioners on one platform
Dedicated subdomain ecosystem (client portal, consultant portal, library, support desk)
Expert-guided approach with professional consultant vetting (not a directory, a managed platform)
Global Ayurveda Library (ayurvedalibrary.org) as an educational moat and SEO asset
gaps: No extracted page-data available — individual page extractions were not completed, limiting depth of color, CTA, and schema analysis
No visible testimonials, case studies, or social proof on homepage — 'Real Conversations' section exists but lacks concrete customer stories with outcomes
Pricing information not visible — visitors cannot determine consultation costs before committing to registration
No blog or content marketing engine — only one blog post exists, missing SEO growth opportunity
Multiple draft/unused homepage versions (15+ drafts detected) suggest site is in prolonged redesign limbo
FAQ redirects to external Freshdesk — breaks user experience and on-site engagement
No clear practitioner value proposition homepage section — 'For Consultants' CTA lacks context on why practitioners should join
Likely missing JSON-LD schema (LocalBusiness, MedicalBusiness, HealthAndBeautyBusiness) for enhanced search visibility
Likely missing analytics tracking setup — no evidence of GA, Pixel, or event tracking
No mobile-responsive indicators detected — critical for health/wellness audience browsing on mobile
No OG/social meta tags evident for social sharing optimization
Terms & Privacy pages likely present but no About/Team page to build trust and humanize the brand
Dual CTA (Client vs Consultant) on homepage without clarifying copy may cause visitor confusion and bounce
No email capture or newsletter signup for retargeting and audience building
One blog post is dated 2025 with no content cadence — content marketing and topical authority are unaddressed
opportunities: Build a structured content engine around dosha types (Vata/Pitta/Kapha), seasonal routines, and wellness guides — high-intent SEO topics
Add a 'How It Works' step-by-step for both clients and consultants to clarify the dual conversion paths
Integrate Freshdesk FAQ on-site rather than redirecting — or embed via iframe/widget
Publish practitioner profiles and success stories as social proof
Create an About page featuring founders/practitioners to build trust in this health-adjacent space
Add transparent pricing tiers or consultation packages
Implement schema markup (HealthAndBeautyBusiness, Physician, FAQ) for rich search results
